name: Feng Liu Ti Tang Qi Xian Jun
source:
It’s a gender-bent version of a popular Chinese mythology, the Seven Fairies. According to legend, the Heavenly Emperor has seven sons. All of them are attractive and unique in their own ways. In this dating sim, you get to play as two different main characters, either a princess or the daughter of a restaurant owner. Each of their routes includes three romantic interests. As a human girl, will you ever fall in love with the son of Heaven?

[From [url=https://mayflowerstudiogames.itch.io/heavenly-princes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作是对中国著名神话“七仙女”的性别转换改编。传说中，天帝有七个儿子，每个人都英俊迷人，各有独特之处。在这款恋爱模拟游戏中，你可以扮演两位不同的主角：一位公主，或一名餐馆老板的女儿。每位主角的路线都有三位可攻略对象。作为凡间女子，你会爱上天帝之子吗？

[来源：[url=https://mayflowerstudiogames.itch.io/heavenly-princes]Itch.io[/url]]
